scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-games.mjs && node scripts/size-report.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.functions.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=glitchbound --branch=pre-release
scripts.dev:api: wrangler d1 migrations apply glitchbound --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply neon-rush-leaderboard --local && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
